tweet_summary: James Woods (5.3M followers) posts an image purporting to show Barack Obama bowing deeply before Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, framing it as 'the absolute low point in American history.'
why_note_decision: The image is a doctored composite presented as a real event to a mass audience. A reader benefits from knowing it is fabricated and that the two men never met, so a debunking note is clearly warranted.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note establishes that the image is fabricated/altered, not a real photograph of an actual meeting. The strongest note identifies the composite: the Obama portion is from a 2009 White House photo of Obama bending down so a boy could touch his hair (Pete Souza), and the Khamenei portion is from a 2005 Tehran photo (Ahmadinejad's inauguration); Obama and Khamenei never met in person. A note that merely says 'this looks edited' without asserting it is fake/that no such meeting happened is too weak. Must cite at least one credible debunk (AFP/Reuters/PolitiFact/Snopes fact-check or the original Flickr/AP source). Do NOT treat the image as authentic.
reference_note: This image is altered. It combines a 2009 White House photo of Obama letting a boy touch his hair with a 2005 photo of Ayatollah Khamenei at Ahmadinejad's inauguration. Obama and Khamenei never met.    https://www.flickr.com/photos/obamawhitehouse/4291874710  https://apnews.com/article/archive-fact-checking-5113960004  https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/image-barack-obama-bowing-ayatollah-khamenei-is-fake-2023-11-09

fact_check.claim_verdict: False: the image is a doctored composite of a 2009 Obama photo and a 2005 Khamenei photo; the two never met.
fact_check.notes: AFP, Reuters, Snopes and PolitiFact all confirm the composite. Obama portion = Pete Souza 2009 White House photo (boy touching his hair); Khamenei portion = Atta Kenare 2005 photo from Ahmadinejad's inauguration (Ahmadinejad originally stood where Obama is pasted).

importance.lens_rationale: 1.27M impressions on a fabricated image stoking US-Iran hostility from a 5.3M-follower account; correcting manufactured visual propaganda about foreign policy has real epistemic/geopolitical value.
